questions.q: Where do you configure Power BI Desktop's connection to Python?
options: File → Options and settings → Options → Python scripting
Home → Get Data → Python
It configures itself automatically with no settings screen
View → Python Settings
questions.explain: The Python scripting page under Options is the single screen connecting Power BI Desktop to a specific Python installation.

questions.q: What does the 'Detected Python home directories' dropdown control?
options: Which installed Python, on a machine that may have more than one, Power BI actually uses to run scripts
Which Python IDE opens when editing a script externally
The Power BI report's file save location
The version of Power BI Desktop itself
questions.explain: If multiple Python installations exist, this dropdown determines exactly which one Power BI runs scripts through — it must point to the installation where pandas and matplotlib were actually installed.

questions.q: If nothing appears in the 'Detected Python home directories' dropdown at all, what does that usually indicate?
options: The 'Add python.exe to PATH' checkbox from installation was likely missed
Power BI Desktop needs to be completely reinstalled
Pandas was installed but Matplotlib wasn't
This is normal and requires no action
questions.explain: An empty detection dropdown is the classic symptom of skipping the PATH checkbox during Python's installation — worth revisiting that step rather than only working around it here.

questions.q: What does the 'Detected Python IDEs' setting actually control?
options: Which code editor opens when editing a Python script outside Power BI — it has no effect on whether scripts execute inside Power BI
Whether Python scripts are allowed to run at all
The same thing as 'Detected Python home directories'
Which version of pandas gets installed
questions.explain: The IDE setting is purely about which external editor opens for convenience — it's entirely separate from the home directory setting that actually makes scripts run.

questions.q: What happens if you try to use Python inside Power BI without a valid installation configured?
options: A clear warning appears indicating Python isn't installed or found
Power BI silently ignores the Python step with no message
Power BI Desktop crashes entirely
Power BI automatically downloads and installs Python for you
questions.explain: Power BI shows an explicit warning message when Python can't be found — the signal to go back to the Python scripting settings screen and fix the home directory.
